story.titleZh: 博塔斯也生病了，墨西哥城赛道缺少安东内利
story.summaryZh: 博塔斯也加入了生病的名单，墨西哥城赛道缺少安东内利，梅赛德斯表示他在恢复中。
story.originalTitle: You can add Valtteri Bottas to this list too, who is also unwell It’s a tough schedule of three consecutive triple-headers to end the season and a fe...
story.summaryEn:
You can add Valtteri Bottas to this list too, who is also unwell
It’s a tough schedule of three consecutive triple-headers to end the season and a few in the paddock seem to be struggling after Austin #F1Chris Medland: No Kimi Antonelli at the track in Mexico City today
Mercedes says he is recovering from a viral illness:
“As a precaution, the FIA have excused him from his mandatory media duties to give him the chance to rest head of the weekend. We expect him to be back tomorrow” #F1
detailZh:
您也可以把瓦尔特里·博塔斯加入这个名单，他也不舒服
结束赛季的连续三个三连冠赛程很艰难，而且有几个在维修区的人似乎也在努力应对奥斯汀的比赛 #F1
Chris Medland：今天墨西哥城的赛道上没有基米·安东内利
梅赛德斯表示他正在从病毒性疾病中恢复：
“作为预防措施，国际汽联已经免除他本周末的强制性媒体任务，以便他有机会休息。我们期待他明天回来” #F1
detailEn:
You can add Valtteri Bottas to this list too, who is also unwell
It’s a tough schedule of three consecutive triple-headers to end the season and a few in the paddock seem to be struggling after Austin #F1Chris Medland: No Kimi Antonelli at the track in Mexico City today
Mercedes says he is recovering from a viral illness:
“As a precaution, the FIA have excused him from his mandatory media duties to give him the chance to rest head of the weekend. We expect him to be back tomorrow” #F1
